question: Can one agent loop, driving all five staged level-20 characters of the party through what their clients see, walk from Silverpine Forest into Shadowfang Keep and defeat Archmage Arugal?
note: A probe of deadmines@7's shape on Shadowfang Keep: one arm, agents 1, on the release image with no args, one agent driving the same five characters in the same member order and roles (the five-class reference party, infra/fixtures/loadouts.ts), staged on silverpine-keep (infra/fixtures/scenarios.ts) at level 20, the cell carrying the leader's start, the end on a kill of Archmage Arugal (creature entry 4275) as kill-target, told nothing to the model, and @7's budget (the four-hour clock, idle 20 minutes, the no-XP watchdog off, the 8000-call guard), wiki on without coordinates, resume false, one attempt a square. Unscored. The objectives are @7's with only the party's location, the portal's coordinates (the entrance trigger's centre, rounded as @7 rounds its own), the dungeon and the boss substituted. Not published: it reaches the fleet only when the operator publishes it and enables its store row. Assignments are the store row's: the roster entry sub-fable-52.

cells.note: The party; its start is the leader's, the Human Warrior tank.

arms.note: One agent driving all five characters, on the release image.

objective: You play every member of a party of five: Tankpartyb (warrior, the party leader), Healpartyc (priest), Magepartyd (mage), Roguepartye (rogue) and Palapartyf (paladin). Tankpartyb is the party's tank, Healpartyc its healer, and Magepartyd, Roguepartye and Palapartyf its damage. The party stands in Silverpine Forest, a few yards from the portal into Shadowfang Keep at (-229, 1576, 79). The objective for this run is for the party to clear Shadowfang Keep and defeat Archmage Arugal.
